# Reference vectors

- SipHash: `veorq/SipHash` commit `32d067603b93b47828700880649198e0bfbbcffa`,
  [official vectors](https://github.com/veorq/SipHash/blob/32d067603b93b47828700880649198e0bfbbcffa/vectors.h)
  for message lengths 0–63. Extended vectors were generated by the same revision's
  official `siphash.c`; message byte i is i modulo256.
- UUIDv47: `stateless-me/uuidv47` commit `81b4025249cdd99e31ee633f756c26b3b8268e73`,
  [reference header](https://github.com/stateless-me/uuidv47/blob/81b4025249cdd99e31ee633f756c26b3b8268e73/uuidv47.h).
  The 32 facade fixtures were generated by compiling this unmodified header in C,
  using four keys and eight UUIDs covering timestamp/random-field boundaries.

Hex hash columns represent unsigned numeric words; official SipHash output bytes
were decoded little endian. Tests validate both facade directions independently,
so an internally consistent but incompatible round trip cannot pass.
